title: Housing - Tech
description: Home for Good Act (via House Floor Amendment No. 2, replacing the original technical Housing-Tech bill). Creates a statewide Home for Good Program, coordinated by IHDA and ICJIA, to provide permanent and transitional affordable housing plus reentry/case-management services to people released from IDOC custody on or after 1/1/2027. Requires IHDA to fund acquisition, development, and rehab of housing units and site-based rental subsidies for community-based organizations serving this population; requires ICJIA to fund case management and reentry navigation services and establish regional provider networks. Creates a housing needs assessment tool for people exiting IDOC, a Home for Good Institute (training/TA for CBOs), an Interagency Reentry Workgroup, and a Home for Good Advisory Committee. Effective immediately.

title: Credit for Change
description: Senate companion to HB5287. Credit for Change resets Illinois sentencing laws by motivating rehabilitation from the first day of a person's prison sentence, offering day-for-day credit for good behavior and access to sentence credits for all incarcerated people who are not serving a natural life sentence.
